environment.description: Same EKS 1.27 cluster but namespace 'docservice-prod' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Standards in enforce mode). The restricted profile rejects pods with hostPath volumes and requires runAsNonRoot: true with a non-zero runAsUser. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-and-privilege' with validationFailureAction: Enforce exists that independently blocks any pod spec containing hostPath volume types or securityContext.privileged=true. The pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM role (via IRSA) scoped to s3:GetObject on a specific bucket prefix only — no EBS or host filesystem access. Container image is distroless (no shell, no filesystem utilities beyond the compiled binary).
